claims.claim: The free Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077 is out, with content inspired by the second Edgerunners anime season, dual wielding, more customisation and cross-platform mod support.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire says the free Edgerunners 2 Update is available now and includes content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, dual wielding, more customization options and cross-platform mod support.

claims.claim: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premiered on Netflix on 20 October.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire says Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premiered on Netflix on October 20.

claims.claim: A new quest, starting as a gig from Wakako, has V meet Weak Kingsley, a main character of Edgerunners 2, in a new location, Night City Prison; it is a prequel to the series.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire describes the new quest from Wakako in which V crosses paths with Weak Kingsley in Night City Prison and says it serves as a prequel to the series.

claims.claim: The update adds Weak's outfit, his revolver Coronation, and a radio station, HKGN 102.FM, with tracks from both Edgerunners seasons.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire says players can equip Weak's full outfit and his signature revolver Coronation, and a new radio station HKGN 102.FM plays tracks from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners and Edgerunners 2.

claims.claim: Dual wielding lets players hold a pistol or revolver in each hand; the developers call it one of the most significant combat additions since update 2.0.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire says dual wielding allows a pistol or revolver in each hand and is one of the most significant gameplay additions to combat since Update 2.0 introduced throwing knives.

claims.claim: New glamdoc vendors at five locations customise the look of cyberware with 40 styles; the update also adds 20 hairstyles and several clothing sets.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire says glamdocs offer 40 cyberware styles at five locations, and the update adds 20 new hairstyles and several clothing sets.

claims.claim: Mod support comes through mod.io, with a Mods panel to browse and install supported mods in the game.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire says cross-platform mod support arrives through mod.io integration with a Mods panel for supported community content.

claims.claim: The update adds 12 minor arcana tarot cards, Night City Tours narrated by Richard Night, stash filters and separate save libraries for each V.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire lists 12 new minor arcana tarot cards, Night City Tours narrated by Richard Night, item stash filters and separate save libraries for each V.

claims.claim: Cyberpunk 2077 now supports Xbox Play Anywhere, so one digital purchase covers Xbox Series X|S and PC.
claims.evidence: Xbox Wire says Cyberpunk 2077 now supports Xbox Play Anywhere, with one purchase enabling play on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC and saves transferring.

claims.claim: CD Projekt Red's patch notes say mod support is available on PC, Mac, PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2, with more mods to come over time.
claims.evidence: The Verge quotes the patch notes: the feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2, and more mods will become available over time.

claims.claim: Other changes include DLSS 4.5 support, glasses-free 3D effects and a field of view slider for console players.
claims.evidence: The Verge lists DLSS 4.5 support, glasses-free 3D effects and an FOV slider for console players.

claims.claim: The update launched on 22 October on PC, Mac, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with Switch 2 and the Mac App Store following in the days after.
claims.evidence: The Verge says the update launches on October 22 on PC, Mac, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, and comes to Switch 2 and the Mac App Store in the days to follow, per the patch notes.

claims.claim: The dual wielding comes through a perk called Double Trouble.
claims.evidence: The Verge says the update adds a Double Trouble perk option that allows dual-wielding of pistols and revolvers.

claims.claim: Details of the update leaked before CD Projekt Red's reveal, after a content creator published a video that was later made private.
claims.evidence: Polygon, citing Push Square, says a content creator published a now-private video detailing the update and fans shared the details before it was removed.

claims.claim: Polygon says the leak described the Double Trouble perk in the Cool skill tree and two side quests.
claims.evidence: Polygon says the perk called Double Trouble is introduced to the Cool skill tree and that there are two side quests.
